issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Map and Video exited during concurrent CEF initialization against the same webcache_6613 directory.
issues_found_and_fixed.evidence: Both initial logs ended at the same CEF concurrent initialization retry; both exited 777003. That exit code alone is not treated as a CEF stack trace.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Per-role and per-instance absolute -UserDir under the configured runtime_directory/Clients.
issues_found_and_fixed.verification: Same UE module then started all three roles; three separate cache directories were created; zero concurrent CEF initialization warnings; isolated Video restart passed.

issues_found_and_fixed.issue: Backend unit test access violation in SCOPED_TRACE destruction due to duplicate Google Test DLL runtimes.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Link only GTest::gtest; retain original tests and business parser.
